I can’t inspect Docker from this session because no terminal execution tool is available. Run:

```powershell
docker ps --filter "name=checkout" --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}"
docker inspect --format "{{json .State.Health}}" checkout
```

If unhealthy, inspect diagnostics with:

```powershell
docker inspect --format "{{range .State.Health.Log}}{{.End}} exit={{.ExitCode}} {{.Output}}{{println}}{{end}}" checkout
docker logs --tail 200 checkout
docker restart checkout
```
